source.title: 22 Oct | Claude Opus — Final Supplier Ingestion Reliability & 1,000-Row E2E Gate
source.body:
# RED-TEAM 9-GATE REVIEW — OWNER SPRINT DISCUSSION (22 OCT 2026)

**Timebox target:** 22–23 Oct 2026, **Supplier Ingestion/Product Intelligence pipeline only**. NOT a commitment that all E-commerce Core (Storefront/Admin/Hub/Driver/COD/Customer) finishes in two days. **No auto-Done.** Do not change other statuses until real evidence. One sequential Claude Opus execution agent and existing repo/branch; inspect HEAD first. Destructive and adversarial DB writes only isolated local `_test` Postgres, preserve existing remote Supabase, migrations require owner approval.

**User-approved method:** discuss ONE stage at a time in ChatGPT; record happy path, worst/failure paths, invariant, acceptance/stop gate, then inspect actual BE implementation before fixing. No broad rearchitecture, new dependencies, or fake evidence. Stage pass requires code/DB/role-UI proof, not Linear Done.

## Proposed 9 gates / dependency map

1. **Source intake/auth & file custody:** supplier identity from session, permissions, file acceptance, original retention, retries, source metadata, safe upload.
2. **File recognition + format mapping:** file byte hash vs format fingerprint, header/sheet discovery, remembered supplier-approved format profiles, unknown mapping review, errors.
3. **Row parsing, field semantics and eligibility:** source document meaning (price list vs invoice), raw values, required fields, stock unknown vs zero, cost vs retail, discount/pack/MOQ, scope and accounting.
4. **Canonical identity matching:** barcode/supplier SKU aliases, Arabic/English names, Brand→Line, formulation, size, units, pack count, bundle/promo, conflict hold.
5. **FAST LANE offer safe commit:** verified known SKU updates to own SupplierOffer, price/qty/stock semantics, diff, partial/full snapshot, concurrency/staleness/replays, old PO protection. No AI block.
6. **SLOW LANE Candidate and entity knowledge:** unknown/ambiguous candidates, dedup, reusable Brand/Line/Ingredient, research evidence and unresolved conflicts.
7. **Product intelligence + factual content/media:** usage/INCI/routine placement, cited facts and safety, AR/EN copy and accurate verified front packshot, optional official logos; no fake facts/AI-generated packshot.
8. **Human review/publish and visible outcome:** approve/reject/merge, atomic Product/SKU/alias/offer linkage, owner-authorized publication, no false 20-success UX and sellability check.
9. **Adversarial E2E / pilot signoff:** cross-supplier tenant boundaries, stale/full/partial, race/retry/outage, 1,000 mixed rows and measured timing, browser→DB→Storefront/PO proof, real original supplier file/signoff (if unavailable explicitly BLOCKED).

## Gate-01: Source Intake & File Custody — RED TEAM TEST PLAN (NOT VERIFIED)

* Supplier authenticated, assigned to own supplier scope, upload permitted only by correct role; forged supplierId/body/path blocked, no customer PII/other vendor access.
* Valid actual Excel/CSV inputs (CSV encodings/Arabic or multi-sheet Excel are parsed at gates 2–3), immutable raw attachment with scoped source identity and audit, no unapproved writes to Catalog/Offers upon simple upload.
* Invalid/spoofed extension/MIME, corrupt/empty/unsupported/password-protected, macro-bearing file, upload-size/row/sheet/resource abuse and decompression/zip bomb → bounded REJECT/REVIEW without partial domain effects.
* Duplicate same bytes/supplier, double-click/retry and simultaneous upload → idempotent source outcome/no duplicate business mutations; distinguish same file reused by *different* supplier, and same layout different content for gate 2.
* Network drop/interrupted upload/restart/storage backend unavailable → explicit retryable/error outcome, no phantom 'upload succeeded', no orphaned published product/offer.
* Original file custody: supplier-scope auth for fetch, retention policy, metadata and filename sanitation, no token/key leaked in logs; malware/CSV formula-injection assessment in downstream exports and UI.
* Track source-kind and declared file semantics (PRICE_LIST vs STOCK_OFFER vs SALES_INVOICE) WITHOUT blindly assuming invoice sold qty = on-hand stock; detailed field application follows stage 3.
* Status/outcomes: receipt ID, accepted/rejected/requires review, reason per failure and traceability; **do not mandate new schema/state names before inspecting actual implementation**.
* Test proof required: affected API endpoints/current Git SHA, auth+malicious fixtures, isolated DB before/after and zero unauthorized side effects, source record/asset linkage, retry/dedup behavior, UI state as applicable; PASS/FAIL with blocker.
* No exact file-size or performance threshold invented; inspect existing settings and realistic supplier exports first.

**Current status:** planning/review only; stage 1 and all others remain **UNVERIFIED** until actual repo + isolated tests. Existing SG-01/02 issues marked Done are implementation history, not sufficient acceptance. Next action: start gate 1 with threat cases and existing-code audit; do not jump to stage 2 or code fixes before agreeing the contract.

---

# Execution contract — Thursday 2026-10-22 (Africa/Cairo)

**Owner decision:** Claude Opus is the **sole coding/execution agent** for this final focused Supplier Ingestion / Product Intelligence MVP closure pass. Gemini/Codex are not implementation agents. Claude must NOT access Linear; owner/ChatGPT maintains issues and copies scope to Claude.

**Objective:** Close the existing Supplier → Ingestion → Verified Catalog + Supplier Offer MVP reliability gate, then move to Hub, Delivery and Storefront. **Target: 22 Oct, conditional on passing gates, not a promise of release.** Execution has not started.

## Baseline and limits

* Current branch: `feat/c0-commerce-integration`; P0 hardening was reported committed as `9c22bf7`. Verify actual HEAD, git dirty state, schema and database targets first.
* EVA `01_Baseline_20.xlsx` intake: 20/20 rows persisted, 0 false matches with existing EVA seed SKUs, 0 live catalog products/offers created. Gaps observed: bundle/promo/multipack flags, `Pack Spec` structural normalization, brand/line association, standalone “Facial Wash”, pending enrichment, missing linked facts/content/media, supplier commit UI misleading for unmatched rows. Treat as earlier audit evidence, verify in code and current test DB.
* Existing `GLO-245..GLO-256` are implemented/marked Done but those statuses do **not** establish end-to-end correctness. Reuse, patch, and regress; **do not duplicate or rewrite**.
* Remote Supabase data and all unrelated changes are strictly preserved. Adversarial/destructive tests only on isolated local `_test` PostgreSQL. Remote migrations require owner approval. Never invent barcodes, images, INCI, claims, prices or source evidence.

## Sequential execution checklist

- [ ] **P1 Audit:** trace actual upload→mapping→normalization→match→offer commit / candidate→research→review→publish across NestJS/Prisma/FastAPI/Business UI. Verify DB, identity fields, entry points, timeouts, existing jobs, regressions and current HEAD; record concrete gaps.
- [ ] **P2 Identity:** fix Arabic/English normalization, Brand→Line reviewed aliases, `Facial Wash` taxonomy, form/variant, net size/unit/packCount and separated *single / manufacturer multipack / bundle / promotional label / trade carton*. Hard-veto unresolved conflicts; a similar name, raw LLM confidence, checksum-valid GTIN, arbitrary ±2% or 0.94 cutoff is never sufficient to auto-merge. No synthetic top-50 brands/aliases.
- [ ] **P3 Supplier fast lane:** exact verified SupplierSKU/GTIN+identity→price, quantity/UNKNOWN and discount validation→supplier-scoped batched safe offer updates. New/ambiguous rows go to distinct candidate/research queue. Fast lane must not wait for AI. Stale/out-of-order files, duplicate rows/hash, concurrent suppliers, price/pack anomalies, `PARTIAL_UPDATE` and verified-scope `FULL_SNAPSHOT` safely handled; no blind deactivation or retail selling price edits.
- [ ] **P4 Evidence-led enrichment:** trace and connect live/verified Research→Brand/Line/Category→INCI/Ingredient→Concerns→Routine→Arabic+English content using typed candidate/catalog persistence; field/source provenance, source version and conflicts, true provider status, bounded retry/failed-stage resume. No unsupported claims or fabrication; real exact-match product images required before publish, creative image generation deferred.
- [ ] **P5 Editorial admission:** Admin approve/merge/reject with atomic or failure-safe Catalog Product/SKU + reviewed supplier alias + held offer release; no unreviewed publication; price/stock availability freshness; Supplier UI accurately labels offer commits vs candidates awaiting Admin (not a fake “20 succeeded”).
- [ ] **P6 E2E + performance:** run actual EVA stress files in order (baseline/replay/reimport/multi-supplier/snapshot/Arabic CSV/dirty/identity/price edges). Add 1,000-row mixed fixture covering known/new/ambiguous/invalid, measure real p50/p95 end-to-end and stage times, DB query counts/scaling, memory/throughput, research/AI request budgets and estimated operating cost. Don't label target estimates as benchmarks.
- [ ] **P7 Release evidence:** all relevant regression suites, typecheck, build, DB/API/UI E2E, supplier-scoped browser and catalog+offer store visibility, simulated provider outages/retries, race/replay/stale/partial/full attacks. Scoped Git commits; final PASS/FAIL and GO/NO-GO.

## Hard acceptance gates

* 100% row accounting and explainable outcomes.
* 0 known false auto-merges, unsafe product publication, destructive offer deactivations, stale price overwrites, duplicate committed records in tested golden/adversarial cases.
* Verified critical facts and genuine packshot; ambiguous facts remain UNKNOWN/review.
* Known supplier offer updates persist independently of new-product AI research.
* One or more reviewed real candidates can complete Product→SKU→Alias→Offer→Storefront E2E under real policy gates, with no orphaning.
* Measured 1,000-row performance; identify and fix blocking N+1 or timeout issues; don't promise <5s without measurement.
* **Real original supplier-system exports and approved field semantics are required for final real-world supplier pilot signoff** (per AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#130/AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#143). If unavailable, separate “technical MVP gate passed” from “real-supplier signoff blocked”; do not fabricate evidence.

## Required execution report

Changed files/migrations, exact test commands/outcomes, E2E rows and DB before/after, 20-EVA reconciliation, 1,000-row timings/cost assumptions, provider outage results, blockers/severity and restart command; GO/NO-GO tied to gate evidence. Work sequentially with Claude Opus alone; stop P0 failure before shifting to Hub/Delivery.

**Scope links:** master `GLO-244`; E2E gate `GLO-257`; prior completed SG tickets `GLO-245..GLO-256`.

## Owner working rule — research existing solutions before each fix (22 Oct 2026)

For each newly discovered supplier-pipeline problem: (1) reproduce and characterize failure in current repo, (2) research mature, proven analogous solutions in official vendor docs/standards and production engineering patterns, (3) compare at least a simple reuse/surgical fix vs a heavier alternative for security, bilingual Egyptian supplier data, maintainability, performance and cost, (4) choose minimum safe fit for NestJS/Prisma/PostgreSQL/FastAPI, (5) test negative cases and measure, (6) record decision and evidence in that stage's AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#159.. stage issue. Never copy patterns blindly, create new architecture without evidence, or mark a source recommendation as implemented.
Reference examples already checked for Stage 04:

* Microsoft Dynamics 365 vendor **external product identifiers** support vendor-specific part numbers linked to released items/variants: [https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/product-identifiers](<https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/pim/product-identifiers>)
* GS1 GTIN management guides on formulation, net contents, pack quantity and promotional changes: [https://www.gs1ie.org/tools-services/tools/gtin-management/](<https://www.gs1ie.org/tools-services/tools/gtin-management/>)
* PostgreSQL pg_trgm official docs for indexed typo/fuzzy candidate retrieval, not authoritative entity identity: [https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/pgtrgm.html](<https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/pgtrgm.html>)
  Application to ShinaCare: reviewed SupplierSKU→CanonicalSKU alias, guard against reuse and pack changes, pg_trgm only when cache misses, independently verify identity before offer commit. New suppliers and Arabic labels require own realistic fixtures. Source links are design references, NOT verified local implementation or guaranteed correctness.

## Stages 08 and 09 finalized for DESIGN (22 Oct 2026), NOT code acceptance

* [GLO-280](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-280>) Stage 08: verified editorial review + pre-publication re-dedup, eligible supplier offer comparison on common unit and realistic landed total cost/MOQ/freshness, independently approved customer SellingPrice, atomic product/SKU/alias/offer publication. Owner approval and price truth remain separate from source Excel.
* [GLO-281](<https://linear.app/ahme-hassan/issue/GLO-281>) Stage 09: real Supplier UI/API/DB cross-stage E2E, 1000 mixed+known fixtures, performance/cost/negative/security/failure testing, and original supplier-file proof. AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#143 remains original real-file pilot tracker and AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#114 remains later public commerce launch gate.
* Research precedents reviewed: Oracle NetSuite multi-vendor purchase prices, Microsoft Dynamics vendor pricing and multisource MOQ/time rules, Shopify separate item cost/sale price, PostgreSQL UPSERT/Prisma transaction and Playwright/OWASP safety. Do NOT build a second price/sourcing engine or install ERP/testing vendor products. No supplier price mean/median is a true consumer market rate or an approved retail price; median is anomaly review signal only when enough comparable quotes.
* The nine stage child AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#159..AhmedHassanDev1/shena-care#167 represent a finite **acceptance/gap-evidence** structure. Earlier SG-01..11 Done remains implementation history; no new pass claimed, no destructive tests on Supabase, supplier hard-stop stands. Timebox user goal 22-23 Oct is best effort for supplier gate only, not EC-01..07 operational launch.
